description: This file defines the LicenceAcceptanceController class within the installer module, responsible for managing the license acceptance screen in the installation process of the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract controller and sets up the component for the license acceptance view.

classes.name: LicenceAcceptanceController
classes.description: Controller for handling the license acceptance step during installation, extending the abstract installer Vue controller.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the license acceptance view component and updates the current screen state during the pre-rendering phase.
